data.speaker: manya
data.text: Waddle! Hello friend! My feathers are vibrating because the school term is finally commencing its end. Do you know what that means?

data.speaker: polly
data.text: It means VACATION, Manya! SQUAWK! I’ve already contacted my pen-pal in London to tell her we are going up-country to the rural village!

data.speaker: kiki
data.text: Meow! Hold your whiskers. We need to prepare. We have to check our report cards first. I hope none of us need remedial classes!

questions.prompt: Manya and friends used many new words. Which word do you think describes a 'friend you write to'?
If Kiki mentions the 'Urban' city, what is the opposite place they are traveling to?

rules.title: Town vs. Village
rules.exampleB: We grow crops in the rural area.
rules.teacherNote: PLE Tip: 'Up-country' is a synonym for Rural.

data.speaker: manya
data.text: Waddle! You are a word master! Should we review the rules one more time, or continue our journey to the village?

data.speaker: polly
data.text: SQUAWK! Look at the bus! I am thinking of traveling, but Manya is planning. He is using the GOING TO structure to show his intent!

rules.title: The Intent Formula
rules.exampleA: Manya is going to board the bus.
rules.exampleB: We are going to board the bus.
rules.explainA: Use 'is' for Manya, He, or She.
rules.explainB: Use 'are' for We, They, or You.
rules.teacherNote: Use 'am' only for 'I' (I am going to...)

questions.prompt: I shall cook rice. (Use: going to)
questions.expected: I am going to cook rice

questions.prompt: Polly will fly up-country. (Use: going to)
questions.expected: Polly is going to fly up-country

data.speaker: kiki
data.text: Meow! While we ride, let's play Question Tags. If the statement is positive, the tag is negative. It’s like a mirror, isn't it?

questions.prompt: Manya is going to the village, _______?
We won't stay in town, _______?
The holiday has commenced, _______?
Polly can fly very fast, _______?
You didn't pay the fare, _______?
Let us go for vacation, _______?
I am right, _______?
The bus will arrive late, _______?
They don't have a plan, _______?
Kiki is a clever cat, _______?

data.speaker: manya
data.text: Wait! Polly is telling the other passengers what the teacher said. She is using Reported Speech! You must shift the tense back in time.

rules.title: Shifting Back
rules.explainA: The words spoken at the moment.
rules.explainB: Telling someone later what was said.
rules.teacherNote: We use 'that' to join the two parts of the sentence.

questions.prompt:
Direct: 'I am going home.'
Reported: He said that he _______ going home.

Direct: 'We will enjoy.'
Reported: They said that they _______ enjoy.

Direct: 'The fare is high.'
Reported: She said the fare _______ high.

data.speaker: kiki
data.text: We are finally here! The village is so BEAUTIFUL. 'Beautiful' is an ADJECTIVE. I can make more adjectives by adding suffixes like -ful or -ing!

rules.title: Adding Suffixes
rules.explainB: Suffix -ing describes the thing causing the feeling.
rules.teacherNote: I am excited (feeling). The trip is exciting (describing)!

questions.prompt: Manya had a _______ (wonder) time.
The movie was very _______ (interest).
Polly is a _______ (help) parrot.
Rural life is very _______ (peace).

data.speaker: manya
data.text: We've reached our destination! Goodbye for now. Let's meet at the stream tomorrow to swim together!
